cirque-colors-nail-polish: Smooth, self-leveling jellies and magnetics, though sheer jellies need several coats.
cnd-shellac: Soaks off in minutes and is gentle on natural nails; chips and lifts for several long-time users.
cnd-solaroil: Cuticle oil credited with stronger nails and less peeling; the strong scent is the main complaint.
cuccio-revitalizing-cuticle-oil: Soaks in without a greasy film and keeps nails soft at good value; the strong scent bothers some.
dazzle-dry-nail-lacquer: Dries in minutes without a lamp and outlasts gel for many; chipping and price are the complaints.
deborah-lippmann-nail-lacquer: Easy to apply and glossy, with standout glitters; some found it streaky or not worth the price.
essie-break-fix-liquid-nail-patch: Flexible patch over peeling layers or small cracks; it did not hold bigger splits for a couple.
essie-gel-couture: Plump gloss lasting a week or two, but shrinkage is the main downside, especially in thick coats.
essie-gel-couture-top-coat: Plump, glossy finish that lasts about a week; shrinkage at the tips grows as the bottle ages.
essie-gel-setter-top-coat: Thick, gel-like shine that dries fairly fast; shrinkage is the most frequent complaint.
essie-good-to-go-top-coat: Fast drying and glossy with little shrinkage, often preferred to Seche Vite; a few found it stringy.
essie-hard-to-resist-advanced-nail-stren: Strengthens thin, brittle nails and cuts peeling with a glossy finish; as a base it lasts a week.
essie-nail-polish: Creme shades and a nice brush, but chipping within days is the biggest complaint.
essie-speed-setter-fast-dry-top-coat: Dries very fast, often preferred to Seche Vite; a few say it gets gummy mid-bottle.
essie-strong-start-base-coat: Gentle PVB-free base that helps peeling and is many people's go-to; a few say it did not help.
glamnetic-press-on-nails: Strong glue gives one to three weeks, though some pop off in days and removal is slow.
holo-taco-nail-oil-pen: Mess-free, refillable way to apply cuticle oil; a couple leaked or broke after months.
holo-taco-nail-polish: Opaque, often one-coat cremes with a week of wear; a thick formula is the most common complaint.
ilnp-nail-polish: Good value for a week of wear, but bottles thicken over months and many find it sheer.
kiss-colorfx-by-impress: Easy to apply and remove at good value; some dislike the exposed sticky edge.
kiss-impress-press-on-manicure: Natural looks with no nail damage for a week or two; some lift within days.
kokoist-color-gel: Highly pigmented and easy to apply, often opaque in one or two coats; the magnetics underwhelm some.
manucurist-green-nail-polish: Thin, quick-drying and gentle on nails; some need two coats and a couple find the smell strong.
mooncat-getting-even-nail-primer: Ridge-filling tinted base that blurs the nail line and dries fast; a few say it does not last.
mooncat-nail-polish: Wears longer than other brands and has well-liked brushes; the thick formula can need thinner.
mooncat-speed-demon-top-coat: Dries fast and hard with a plump gloss; it turns thick and stringy around halfway.
mylee-gel-polish: Easy to apply, long-lasting and good value for beginners; cream shades often need two coats.
nails-inc-nail-polish: Self-leveling, easy to apply and long wearing in a week of use; some shades run thick and streaky.
olive-june-gel-polish: Beginner-friendly gel with good results for a week or two; some shades are sheer.
olive-june-pressies: Adult press-ons fit well and last about two weeks; the kids' size did not stay on for a couple.
opi-drip-dry: Makes polish touch-dry in a minute or two with a clean dropper; oily and runny around the cuticles.
opi-nature-strong-base-coat: Gentle on thin nails and lasts through a night for several; a few still got peeling.
opi-repair-mode-bond-building-nail-serum: Quickly strengthens peeling nails, though a notable group saw lifting or dryness.
opi-xpress-on: Two weeks or more even on hard-working hands; a few found the curve too strong.
orly-gelfx-builder-in-a-bottle: Easy for beginners with wear of weeks to months; thick like heavy polish, so shaping takes practice.
orly-nail-lacquer: Comfortable paddle brush and big bottles, often preferred to OPI; lighter shades are sheer.
sally-hansen-color-therapy: Goes on easily with a flat brush and lasts about a week; a couple found it chipped in chunks.
sally-hansen-dries-instantly-top-coat: Dries within minutes with a shine that lasts; a couple found it cracked their polish.
sally-hansen-hard-as-nails: Cheap base coat that helps polish last; others say it made nails brittle or did nothing.
sally-hansen-insta-dri-top-coat: Fast drying at a low price with little shrinkage; chipping or cracking is the main complaint.
sally-hansen-miracle-gel: Lasts a week or more without a UV lamp; chipping and a thick formula bother some.
sally-hansen-miracle-gel-top-coat: Shiny with minimal shrinkage, good over magnetics; it dries slower than quick-dry options.
sally-hansen-vitamin-e-nail-cuticle-oil: Dependable store-bought cuticle oil that wearers rebuy, with a small brush.
seche-vive-instant-gel-effect-top-coat: Quick-drying gel-like shine that shrinks less than Seche Vite; the smell is strong.
